title: Unit test feeds world-px band values where the production call site passes screen px; the test's own 11.9 comment proves the mismatch
evidence:
+congested_halo_width :: proc(band_screen, scale: f32) -> f32 {
+	return max(band_screen + 5.0 * scale, CONGESTION_HALO_FLOOR_WORLD * scale)
+}
...
+	// engages at Core fit (8.5 -> 12) and Distribution (11.9 -> 16.8);
...
+		{3.5, 1.4, "Distribution"},
...
+	expect_f32(t, congested_halo_width(4.5, 2.0), 24.0) // max(9+10, 24) at scale 2 — LITERALS, not the law restated
...
+				w := congested_halo_width(band, v.scale)
(old line: -				w := band + 5.0 * v.scale)
detail: At draw_bundles, band is screen px (old code band + 5.0*scale). The test pairs pass world px (3.5 with scale 1.4 computes 10.5; the comment's 11.9 needs band_screen 4.9). Assertions pass only because the floor dominates; the classic-bump leg checks the wrong base.
recommended_fix: Feed screen-px band values (world × scale) mirroring the draw_bundles call, and correct the 11.9/9+10 comments; keep the floor-dominance literal expectations.

title: Palcheck §8 routed branch (d)+(e) indexes pipe_congestion unguarded, unlike legs (a)/(b)/(c)
evidence:
+		if testing_lvl_ok {
...
+		// (d)+(e): the ROUTED branch — the "ONE look" invariant is a PIN,
...
+		{
+			sv_rw := view.route_wires
+			defer view.route_wires = sv_rw
+			view.route_wires = true

+			state.crisis.pipe_congestion[ps8] = .Amber
detail: Legs (a)-(c) are gated on testing_lvl_ok; the routed block has no such guard. If the fixture fails to resolve and the resize never ran, pipe_congestion[ps8] panics instead of the premise check reporting cleanly.
recommended_fix: Wrap the (d)+(e) block body in the same `if testing_lvl_ok { ... }` guard used by legs (a)-(c).

title: §8 array-write gate omits the edit-error result the premise check requires
evidence:
+		testing_lvl_ok := ok_ps && found_bi
...
+		check(testing_lvl_ok && perr8 == .None,
+			fmt.aprintf("section-8 premise: the fixture resolves (pipe err %v, bundle found %v)", perr8, found_bi), int(ps8))
detail: testing_lvl_ok gates the resize/index of pipe_congestion but excludes perr8; the premise check treats perr8 == .None as required. A failed edit that still yields ok pipe_slot would pass the gate and write through an invalid slot.
recommended_fix: Include perr8 == .None in testing_lvl_ok so the gate and the premise check are one predicate.

...

title: Out-of-band zoom override silently ignored in run_motion_strip but usage-errors in main
evidence:
+	strip_zoom := demo.zoom
+	if zoom_override >= 1.0 && zoom_override <= 4.0 {
+		strip_zoom = zoom_override
+	}
...
+				if !okz || !(z >= 1.0 && z <= 4.0) { // the NaN-rejecting band test (demo-parser parity)
+					usage()
detail: main rejects out-of-band zoom with usage(); run_motion_strip's same band check silently falls back to demo.zoom. Non-main or default-param callers get fit-altitude evidence where per-rung evidence was requested, contradicting the self-describing-summary intent.
recommended_fix: Return an error (or assert) when zoom_override is non-zero and out of band, rather than silently ignoring it.

title: measure_color_run's contract comment orphaned above the inserted scan_col_v
detail: The three pre-existing comment lines describe measure_color_run, but scan_col_v (with its own doc block) is inserted between them and their function, leaving the old contract attached to the wrong proc.
